shortDescription: Samsung Electronics Co.’s anticipated equity buyback is fueling expectations it will purchase non-voting preferred shares, according to Bloomberg.The move could narrow the preferred stock discount, which stands at 45%, and may set a precedent for other companies in South Korea.

title: Samsung Buyback May Narrow Korea’s 45% Preferred Share Discount
